title: Serial/date-time representations are exact and non-negotiable

sourceObjects.ref: explicit structured input: serial/date-time format specification

concepts.name: serialDate
concepts.dateTimeRepresentation: ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds, e.g. 2025-01-02T03:04:05.678Z; never local time, never epoch seconds, never a serial integer
concepts.failureBehavior: any representation outside ISO-8601 UTC is rejected as malformed

factsEstablished.fact: serial dates are ISO-8601 UTC with milliseconds
